looks.en: Sleek jet-black hair in a low knot, sharp grey-green eyes and a strong jaw; a tailored charcoal trench over a black turtleneck, a thin gold signet ring on one hand.
looks.zh: 乌黑顺直的头发挽成低髻，灰绿色的眼睛锐利，下颌线分明；炭灰色修身风衣配黑色高领毛衣，一只手上戴着细金印章戒指。

looks.en: Shoulder-length dark brown waves with an auburn sheen, the same grey-green eyes as her sister but steadier, faint lines at the corners; a deep burgundy wool coat and pearl drop earrings.
looks.zh: 齐肩深棕色波浪发泛着赤褐光泽，和妹妹一样的灰绿眼睛却更沉稳，眼角有细纹；深酒红色羊毛大衣，戴珍珠垂坠耳环。

looks.en: Lean and a little rumpled, messy brown hair, tortoiseshell glasses and a five-o'clock shadow; an oatmeal cardigan over a button-down, sleeves pushed up, a library lanyard.
looks.zh: 清瘦、略显凌乱，蓬乱的棕发，玳瑁框眼镜，下巴一层胡茬；燕麦色开衫套在衬衫外，袖子推到小臂，挂着图书馆工牌。

looks.en: Broad-shouldered Black man with a close fade, a neat short beard, warm brown eyes and a big easy grin; olive utility jacket, treat pouch on his belt and a rolled leather leash over one shoulder.
looks.zh: 肩宽的黑人男子，短渐变发，整齐的短胡子，温暖的棕色眼睛，笑容大而随意；橄榄绿工装夹克，腰间挂零食袋，肩上斜挎一卷皮质牵引绳。

looks.en: Lean and wiry with sandy-red hair under a patterned bandana, a short copper beard, freckles and pale blue eyes that look away when complimented; flour up to the elbows, a white baker's apron over a faded black tee.
looks.zh: 精瘦，沙红色头发压在花纹头巾下，短短的铜色胡子，满脸雀斑，被夸时浅蓝的眼睛会移开；面粉一直沾到手肘，褪色黑T恤外系白色烘焙围裙。

looks.en: Korean-American with soft black hair falling over his forehead, dimples and a warm open smile; a rust-colored knit sweater with sleeves pushed up and a café towel over his shoulder.
looks.zh: 韩裔美国人，柔软的黑发垂在额前，笑起来有酒窝，温暖坦率；铁锈色针织毛衣袖子挽起，肩上搭着咖啡店抹布。

looks.en: Mexican-American, slim, with a sharp black undercut, expressive dark eyes and a thin silver hoop earring; a paint-spattered denim jacket over a mustard tee, pencil tucked behind his ear.
looks.zh: 墨西哥裔美国人，身形纤细，利落的黑色削边发型，眼睛黑亮有神，戴一只细银耳环；沾满颜料的牛仔夹克配芥末黄T恤，耳后别着铅笔。

looks.en: Big, sun-weathered Southern mechanic with a dirty-blond beard, crinkled blue eyes and grease on his knuckles; a faded navy work shirt with his name patch, sleeves rolled over thick forearms.
looks.zh: 高大、被太阳晒黑的南方修车工，暗金色胡子，蓝眼睛笑起来皱成一团，指节上有机油；褪色藏青工作衬衫缝着名字布标，袖子卷到粗壮的小臂上。

looks.en: Indian-American with glossy wavy black hair, bright amber-brown eyes and a quick grin, trim build; a pink-stained white dress shirt open at the collar, restaurant key ring on one finger.
looks.zh: 印度裔美国人，光亮的黑色卷发，明亮的琥珀棕眼睛，笑得很快，身形匀称；领口敞开的白衬衫被染成粉色，一根手指上转着餐厅钥匙圈。

looks.en: Tall and quiet, 35, salt-and-pepper stubble, short graying dark hair, heavy-lidded hazel eyes; a worn brown leather driver's jacket over a grey henley, a pair of red socks in hand.
looks.zh: 高个、寡言，三十五岁，胡茬黑白相间，短发已见灰白，眼皮微垂的榛色眼睛；旧棕色皮夹克配灰色亨利衫，手里拿着一双红袜子。

looks.en: Lanky with shaggy chestnut hair, a scruffy beard, round wire glasses and a lopsided smile; a faded plaid flannel over a vintage monster-movie tee, a VHS tape in his hand.
looks.zh: 瘦高，蓬松的栗色头发，乱糟糟的胡子，圆框金属眼镜，笑容有点歪；褪色格子法兰绒衬衫里是复古怪兽电影T恤，手里拿着一盘录像带。

looks.en: Black man with neat short locs, a trimmed beard, expressive brows and a rich laugh-lined face; a mustard corduroy jacket over a black turtleneck, studio headphones around his neck.
looks.zh: 黑人男子，整齐的短脏辫，修剪过的胡子，眉眼表情丰富，笑纹明显；芥末黄灯芯绒夹克配黑色高领毛衣，脖子上挂着录音棚耳机。

looks.en: Tall Black man, 34, shaved head, neat grey-flecked beard and calm deep-set eyes; a charcoal three-piece suit with the jacket off, sleeves rolled, long hands resting on piano keys.
looks.zh: 高大的黑人男子，三十四岁，光头，整齐的胡子夹着几丝灰白，眼神沉静深邃；炭灰色三件套西装脱了外套，袖子挽起，修长的手放在琴键上。

looks.en: Filipino-American drummer with tousled black hair, a restless bright-eyed face and a silver ear cuff, compact athletic build; a sweat-damp white tank under an open black shirt, drumsticks in hand.
looks.zh: 菲律宾裔美国鼓手，凌乱的黑发，眼睛明亮总停不下来，戴银色耳骨夹，身形紧实；汗湿的白背心外敞着黑衬衫，手里握着鼓棒。

looks.en: Tall, lean and imperious, long sea-green-black hair wet at the ends, pale gold slit-pupil eyes, faint iridescent teal scales at his throat and wrists; a loose salt-stained linen shirt open at the chest.
looks.zh: 高挑修长，神情骄傲，长发墨绿近黑、发梢湿漉，浅金色竖瞳，喉间与手腕隐约泛着蓝绿虹彩的鳞片；宽松的亚麻衬衫沾着盐渍，胸口敞开。

looks.en: Sturdy, sun-browned surveyor with close-cropped brown curls, a freckled nose, stubble and a friendly squint; a yellow rain shell over a field vest full of pens, a tripod on his shoulder.
looks.zh: 结实、晒成小麦色的测绘员，剪短的棕色卷发，鼻梁有雀斑，下巴有胡茬，眯眼笑得友善；黄色雨壳外套下是插满笔的野外马甲，肩扛三脚架。

looks.en: Pale, angular and dramatic, long black hair with one silver streak, sharp cheekbones, kohl-smudged violet-grey eyes; a black velvet dressing gown over a lace-cuffed shirt, a mug of tea in hand.
looks.zh: 苍白、棱角分明、气质戏剧化，黑色长发中夹一缕银白，高颧骨，晕着眼线的紫灰色眼睛；黑丝绒睡袍里是蕾丝袖口衬衫，手里端着一杯茶。

looks.en: Golden-tanned, broad-shouldered hero with messy honey-blond hair, earnest green eyes and a small scar on his chin; dented steel pauldron over a blue tunic, a sword he keeps forgetting to draw.
looks.zh: 金褐肤色、肩宽的英雄，乱糟糟的蜂蜜金发，真诚的绿色眼睛，下巴有一道小疤；蓝色束腰上衣外罩一块有凹痕的钢肩甲，佩剑却总忘了拔。
